questions.answer: Quis īgnōrat quīn tria Graecōrum genera sint?

questions.answer: Neque Caesarem fefellit quīn ab iīs cohortibus initium victōriae orīrētur.

questions.prompt: Some doubt whether he is coming through Sardinia.
questions.answer: Nōn nūllī dubitant an per Sardiniam veniat.

questions.prompt: Doubt, if you can, by whom Sextus Roscius was murdered.
questions.answer: Dubitāte, sī potestis, ā quō sit Sex. Rōscius occīsus.

questions.prompt: I doubt whether you will receive this very letter.
questions.answer: Dubitābam tū hās ipsās litterās essēsne acceptūrus.

questions.prompt: Nor does age prevent us from retaining an interest in tilling the soil.
questions.answer: Nec aetās impedit quōminus agrī colendī studia teneāmus.

questions.prompt: Nothing hinders us from being able to do that.
questions.answer: Nihil impedit quōminus id facere possīmus.

questions.prompt: He warns him to avoid all suspicion.

questions.prompt: He urges them not to lose heart.

questions.prompt: I beg and pray you to aid him.
questions.answer: Tē rogō atque ōrō ut eum iuvēs.

questions.prompt: He ordered them to search.

questions.prompt: I wish to be a judge, not a teacher.

questions.answer: Mē Caesaris mīlitem dīcī voluī.

questions.prompt: We wish you to reap the fruits of your virtue.
questions.answer: Tē tuā fruī virtūte cupimus.

questions.prompt: I will never desire that you shall hear.
questions.answer: Numquam optābō ut audiātis.

questions.prompt: I allow you to pass by these matters.
questions.answer: Concēdō tibi ut ea praetereās.

questions.prompt: They do not allow wine to be imported.
questions.answer: Vīnum importārī nōn sinunt.

questions.prompt: Let me know as soon as possible.
questions.answer: Cūrā ut quam prīmum intellegam.

questions.prompt: Caesar tried to rebuild the bridges.
questions.answer: Cōnātus est Caesar reficere pontīs.

questions.prompt: Take care and see that he lacks nothing.
questions.answer: Cūrā et prōvidē ut nēquid eī dēsit.

questions.prompt: He feared that he should be disinherited.
questions.answer: Nē exhērēdārētur veritus est.

questions.prompt: I fear the orator grows feeble from old age.
questions.answer: Ōrātor metuō nē languēscat senectūte.

questions.prompt: I fear that I cannot grant you.
questions.answer: Vereor ut tibi possim concēdere.

questions.answer: Quam vellem mē invītāssēs!

questions.answer: Huic mandat Rēmōs adeat.

questions.prompt: I think we must be allowed to use a Greek word.

questions.prompt: We were warned to be careful.
questions.answer: Admonitī sumus ut cavērēmus.

questions.prompt: He was ordered to go into exile.
questions.answer: Īre in exsilium iussus est.

questions.prompt: I brought about his departure from the kingdom.
questions.answer: Perfēcī ut ē rēgnō ille discēderet.

questions.answer: Fēcī ut Flāminium ē senātū ēicerem.

questions.prompt: For it had not happened to be necessary to me.

questions.answer: Spērō fore ut contingat id nōbīs.

questions.answer: Illud etiam restiterat, ut tē in iūs ēdūcerent.

questions.prompt: He endured all rather than betray.
questions.answer: Perpessus est omnia potius quam indicāret.

questions.answer: Opportūnissima rēs accidit quod Germānī vēnērunt.
